draft_en.subject: Second source for the PoE switch in your IP intercom kits - Audio label
draft_en.body:
Hello Audio Elektronik team,

Over the past months you had a product mail from us - "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 20 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches that power your IP intercom systems, we can be a second ODM source in Audio packaging from small lots, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, STC-424DGGPM-280W, $145.7; budget 4/8-PoE unmanaged units for single-villa kits on request. Logo on the unit is free; colour box from 200 sets.

One question: which PoE SKU ships most with your site and villa kits - 4, 8 or 24 ports?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
